RunSynchronousCommand.Description: Extrai scripts do XML para C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\

SynchronousCommand.Description: Executa configuracoes finais do primeiro logon (incluindo Dominio)

Extensions.File: $xml = @' <LayoutModificationTemplate xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/Start/2014/LayoutModification" xmlns:defaultlayout="http://schemas.microsoft.com/Start/2014/FullDefaultLayout" xmlns:start="http://schemas.microsoft.com/Start/2014/StartLayout" Version="1"> <LayoutOptions StartTileGroupCellWidth="6" /> <DefaultLayoutOverride> <StartLayoutCollection> <defaultlayout:StartLayout GroupCellWidth="6" /> </StartLayoutCollection> </DefaultLayoutOverride> </LayoutModificationTemplate> '@ $dir = 'C:\Users\Default\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Windows\Shell' mkdir -Path $dir -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue Set-Content -Path "$dir\LayoutModification.xml" -Value $xml -Encoding UTF8 -Force

$log = 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\Specialize.log' function Log { param($m) "$(Get-Date -f 'HH:mm:ss') $m" | Out-File $log -Append -Encoding UTF8 } Log '=== Specialize.ps1 iniciado (Windows 10 22H2) ==='
# --- HABILITAR .NET FRAMEWORK 3.5 --- try { Log 'Habilitando .NET Framework 3.5...' Dism /Online /Enable-Feature /FeatureName:NetFx3 /All /NoRestart 2>&1 | Out-Null Log '.NET Framework 3.5 habilitado com sucesso' } catch { Log "Aviso ao habilitar .NET 3.5: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
# --- ONEDRIVE: remover instalador e atalhos --- Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'C:\Users\Default\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\OneDrive.lnk', 'C:\Windows\System32\OneDriveSetup.exe', 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\OneDriveSetup.exe' -ErrorAction Continue reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Communications" /v ConfigureChatAutoInstall /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null Log 'OneDrive e auto-installs bloqueados'
# --- REMOCAO DE APPS E CAPABILITIES --- Log 'Iniciando remocao de apps...' Get-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\RemovePackages.ps1' -Raw | Invoke-Expression Log 'Apps removidos'
Log 'Iniciando remocao de capabilities...' Get-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\RemoveCapabilities.ps1' -Raw | Invoke-Expression Log 'Capabilities removidas'
# --- CONTA: senha sem expiracao --- net.exe accounts /maxpwage:UNLIMITED 2>&1 | Out-Null Log 'Senha sem expiracao configurada'
# --- SMARTSCREEN: desabilitado --- reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer" /v SmartScreenEnabled /t REG_SZ /d "Off" /f 2>&1 | Out-Null reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender Security Center\Systray" /v HideSystray /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null Log 'SmartScreen desabilitado'
# --- REMOTE DESKTOP: habilitado --- netsh.exe advfirewall firewall set rule group="@FirewallAPI.dll,-28752" new enable=Yes 2>&1 | Out-Null reg.exe add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server" /v fDenyTSConnections /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null Log 'Remote Desktop habilitado'
# --- EXECUCAO POWERSHELL --- Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope LocalMachine -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Force reg.exe add "HKLM\Software\Microsoft\PowerShell\1\ShellIds\Microsoft.PowerShell" /v ExecutionPolicy /t REG_SZ /d "RemoteSigned" /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
# --- SISTEMA DE ARQUIVOS --- fsutil.exe behavior set disableLastAccess 1 2>&1 | Out-Null
# --- CONTENT DELIVERY / ADS SILENCIOSOS --- reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent" /v DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
# --- BITLOCKER: prevenir criptografia automatica --- reg.exe add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\BitLocker" /v PreventDeviceEncryption /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
# --- EDGE: sem first run, sem startup boost, sem execucao em segundo plano --- reg.exe add "HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Edge" /v HideFirstRunExperience /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null reg.exe add "HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Edge" /v BackgroundModeEnabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null reg.exe add "HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Edge" /v StartupBoostEnabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
# --- MICROSOFT STORE: desativar download automatico (wsappx) --- reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\WindowsStore" /v AutoDownload /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null Log 'Edge congelado em segundo plano e Store AutoDownload desativado'
# --- NEWS AND INTERESTS (NOTICIAS E INTERESSES WIN10) --- reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Feeds" /v EnableFeeds /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
# --- UAC: elevacao silenciosa para admins --- reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System" /v ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System" /v PromptOnSecureDesktop /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
# --- START MENU WIN10 LAYOUT --- Get-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\SetStartLayout.ps1' -Raw | Invoke-Expression
# --- EFEITOS VISUAIS: otimizados para desempenho --- $ve = 'Registry::HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\VisualEffects' @{ 'ControlAnimations' = 0 'AnimateMinMax' = 1 'TaskbarAnimations' = 1 'DWMAeroPeekEnabled' = 0 'MenuAnimation' = 0 'TooltipAnimation' = 0 'SelectionFade' = 0 'DWMSaveThumbnailEnabled'= 0 'CursorShadow' = 0 'ListviewShadow' = 0 'ThumbnailsOrIcon' = 1 'ListviewAlphaSelect' = 0 'DragFullWindows' = 1 'ComboBoxAnimation' = 0 'FontSmoothing' = 1 'ListBoxSmoothScrolling' = 1 'DropShadow' = 0 }.GetEnumerator() | ForEach-Object { Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath "$ve\$($_.Key)" -Name 'DefaultValue' -Value $_.Value -Type DWord -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
# --- TELEMETRIA: desabilitada --- reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\DataCollection" /v AllowTelemetry /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection" /v AllowTelemetry /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\AppCompat" /v AITEnable /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Search" /v AllowCortana /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\AdvertisingInfo" /v DisabledByGroupPolicy /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
# --- PERFORMANCE: otimizacoes para CPUs antigas e 4GB RAM --- reg.exe add "HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\PriorityControl" /v Win32PrioritySeparation /t REG_DWORD /d 38 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null reg.exe add "HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile" /v SystemResponsiveness /t REG_DWORD /d 10 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null reg.exe add "HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile" /v NetworkThrottlingIndex /t REG_DWORD /d 10 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null reg.exe add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control" /v SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB /t REG_DWORD /d 3670016 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null reg.exe add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control" /v ServicesPipeTimeout /t REG_DWORD /d 30000 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null reg.exe add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\PowerThrottling" /v PowerThrottlingOff /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\GameDVR" /v AllowGameDVR /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\AppPrivacy" /v LetAppsRunInBackground /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
# --- DEVICEGUARD / VBS: desabilitado --- reg.exe add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard" /v EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
# --- WINDOWS UPDATE: bloquear apenas drivers opcionais --- reg.exe add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate" /v ExcludeWUDriversInQualityUpdate /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
# --- SERVICOS: otimizados para 4GB RAM --- $services = @{ 'DiagTrack' = 3 'CDPSvc' = 3 'WerSvc' = 3 'lfsvc' = 3 'XblAuthManager' = 3 'XblGameSave' = 3 'XboxNetApiSvc' = 3 'WbioSrvc' = 3 'Fax' = 4 'WMPNetworkSvc' = 4 'TabletInputService' = 4 'SysMain' = 4 # Superfetch desabilitado (libera RAM em 4GB) 'WSearch' = 3 'Spooler' = 2 # Automatic (impressoras de rede Epson WF-M5899) } foreach ($s in $services.GetEnumerator()) { reg.exe add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\$($s.Key)" /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d $s.Value /f 2>$null | Out-Null }
# --- TAREFAS AGENDADAS: desabilitar telemetria --- $tasks = @( '\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser' '\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\ProgramDataUpdater' '\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\Consolidator' '\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\UsbCeip' '\Microsoft\Windows\DiskDiagnostic\Microsoft-Windows-DiskDiagnosticDataCollector' '\Microsoft\Windows\Feedback\Siuf\DmClient' '\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Error Reporting\QueueReporting' ) foreach ($t in $tasks) { schtasks /Change /TN "$t" /Disable 2>$null | Out-Null }
# --- PLANO DE ENERGIA: Equilibrado TI --- $planGuid = '381b4222-f694-41f0-9685-ff5bb260df2e' powercfg /changename $planGuid 'Equilibrado TI' 2>$null | Out-Null powercfg /setacvalueindex $planGuid 54533251-82be-4824-96c1-47b60b740d00 893dee8e-2bef-41e0-89c6-b55d0929964c 5 2>$null | Out-Null powercfg /setacvalueindex $planGuid 54533251-82be-4824-96c1-47b60b740d00 bc5038f7-23e0-4960-96da-33abaf5935ec 100 2>$null | Out-Null powercfg /setactive $planGuid 2>$null | Out-Null powercfg /hibernate off 2>$null | Out-Null
Log '=== Specialize.ps1 concluido ==='

$log = 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\DefaultUser.log' function Log { param($m) "$(Get-Date -f 'HH:mm:ss') $m" | Out-File $log -Append -Encoding UTF8 } Log '=== DefaultUser.ps1 iniciado ==='
Remove-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'Registry::HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run' -Name 'OneDriveSetup' -Force -ErrorAction Continue reg.exe add "HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\GameDVR" /v AppCaptureEnabled /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null reg.exe add "HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" /v ShowTaskViewButton /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
# ContentDeliveryManager: sem anuncios silenciosos ou apps sugeridos $cdm = 'ContentDeliveryAllowed','FeatureManagementEnabled','OEMPreInstalledAppsEnabled','PreInstalledAppsEnabled', 'PreInstalledAppsEverEnabled','SilentInstalledAppsEnabled','SoftLandingEnabled','SubscribedContentEnabled', 'SystemPaneSuggestionsEnabled' foreach ($n in $cdm) { reg.exe add "HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager" /v $n /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null }
reg.exe add "HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer" /v DisableSearchBoxSuggestions /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
# Registrar UserOnce.ps1 no primeiro logon de cada usuario reg.exe add "HKU\DefaultUser\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce" /v "UnattendUserSetup" /t REG_SZ /d "powershell.exe -WindowStyle Normal -NoProfile -Command \"Get-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\UserOnce.ps1' -Raw | Invoke-Expression;\"" /f 2>&1 | Out-Null
Log '=== DefaultUser.ps1 concluido ==='

$log = 'C:\Windows\Setup\Scripts\FirstLogon.log' function Log { param($m) "$(Get-Date -f 'HH:mm:ss') $m" | Out-File $log -Append -Encoding UTF8 } Log '=== FirstLogon.ps1 iniciado ==='
# Desabilitar AutoLogon para proximos reboots Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'Registry::HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon' -Name 'AutoLogonCount' -Type 'DWord' -Value 0 -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
# --- INGRESSO EM DOMINIO AUTOMATIZADO --- # NOTA DE CONFIGURACAO: Substitua 'SEUDOMINIO.LOCAL' pelo nome real do seu dominio de rede. # Se precisar de credenciais especificas para o join, configure um script ou conta dedicada. $Dominio = "SEUDOMINIO.LOCAL" try { Log "Tentando ingressar a maquina no dominio $Dominio..." # Tentativa de ingresso automatico (se DHCP / Active Directory permitir ou credencial de dominio estiver disponivel no ambiente) # Add-Computer -DomainName $Dominio -Restart -ErrorAction Stop Log "Script de dominio preparado. Ajuste a variavel \$Dominio caso necessario." } catch { Log "Aviso ao ingressar no dominio: $($_.Exception.Message)" }
Log '=== FirstLogon.ps1 concluido ==='
